project: 中華醫事科技大學 cinematic vertical promo

global_direction.pacing: Fast-paced retention edit with a visible change every 1 second.
global_direction.typography: Large Traditional Chinese kinetic typography, bold modern Taiwanese youth style, white outlined subtitles.
global_direction.audio: Epic emotional cinematic hybrid trailer music with bass drops, whoosh transitions, and uplifting climax.
global_direction.color_grade: Netflix cinematic contrast, Korean soft glow, warm sunset tones, high contrast highlights.

timeline.title: Opening hook
timeline.visual: Massive cinematic text over dark futuristic medical light bloom.
timeline.text:
你的未來，
不該只是想像。
timeline.motion: Bass impact, type punch-in, RGB glitch tear, hard whoosh transition.

timeline.title: Modern campus sunrise
timeline.visual: Sunlight shines across a modern university campus while students walk in slow motion; drone flies through campus corridors.
timeline.text: 陽光穿越校園，夢想開始加速
timeline.motion: Drone push-through, speed ramp, warm lens flare.

timeline.title: Nursing emergency rescue
timeline.visual: Nursing students practice emergency rescue training; focused eyes in extreme close-up; medical equipment glows cinematically.
timeline.text: 專注雙眼，救護現場的每一秒
timeline.motion: Handheld realism, cut-ins on hands and eyes, heartbeat bass pulse.

timeline.title: AI smart healthcare lab
timeline.visual: AI smart healthcare laboratory with holographic medical HUD floating in air and futuristic healthcare technology.
timeline.motion: HUD parallax, particle scan, neon cyan reveal.

timeline.title: Optometry department
timeline.visual: Optometry students operate advanced instruments in ultra-clean white lab aesthetics with Korean commercial lighting.
timeline.text: 高階儀器，白色實驗室美學
timeline.motion: Clean dolly move, white flash cut, precision macro close-up.

timeline.title: Campus youth freedom
timeline.visual: Students laugh in cafeteria; basketball court at sunset; youthful freedom and university energy.
timeline.motion: Golden-hour handheld, jump cuts, ball bounce speed ramp.

timeline.title: High-tech close-up montage
timeline.visual: Lab coats, medical uniforms, high-tech devices, and students using AI systems.
timeline.motion: Macro detail flashes, UI overlays, light streak transitions.

timeline.title: Future career montage
timeline.visual: Graduation, hospital internship, professional certification, and future career success.
timeline.text: 畢業・實習・證照・未來職涯
timeline.motion: Fast montage, rising orchestral impact, certification shine.

timeline.title: Rooftop finale and logo reveal
timeline.visual: Students stand together on rooftop at sunset; orbit camera, lens flare, wind blowing, golden sunset logo reveal.
timeline.text:
中華醫事科技大學
下一個主角，就是你
timeline.motion: Orbit camera, wind-swept silhouettes, emotional climax, cinematic fade out.
